# Wachete

Wachete is a web monitoring service that allows users to track changes on web pages and receive notifications based on specified criteria.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wachete/.

## Actions

- **Create Watcher**: Create a new watcher.
- **Get folder content** (read-only): Retrieve the content of a folder.
- **List watchers** (read-only): List all watchers.
- **Delete watcher**: Delete a watcher.
- **List notifications** (read-only): List account notifications.
